findings: The visible nine primitives all use the same Material_Accent, so the shell, fan, details and plasma core share a bright cyan treatment in the inspected image; Material_Hull is present but unused.

The exact white albedo payload also appears in the engine-resonator package. An exact-byte and role-guarded 4x4 replacement has matching decoded pixels and BC3, BC7, ASTC and ETC2 blocks at every mip, but has not been integrated into the compiler yet.
